name: Starving Beast
effect: Hungry x2 (I eat 4 candies instead of 1.)
alt: A crazed, starving werewolf beast with sharp claws and fangs, and black ichor drooling from it's mouth.

name: Duchess Nosfyra
effect:
Thirsty (I steal strength and candy from my fights.)
Play/Trick: Steal 2 Candies.
alt: A tall, bald vampiress with sharp, unnaturally long fingers.

name: Lady in White
effect:
Intangible (Damage dealt to me is reduced to one.)
Trick/Treat: Heal all damage from a monster.
alt: A pale ghost of a young cordial-looking girl with somber, purple glowing eyes.

name: Franken Monkey
effect:
Specimen (When I die, bookmark me face-up.)
Dies: Deal 4 damage to a monster.
alt: A grotesque monkey stitched together with various body parts, with an exposed brain and a mechanical tail.

name: Bog Witch
effect:
Tricky (I can play tricks of any class.)
When you play a trick, create a Toad.
alt: A young, silly witch girl riding a broomstick casually with a her toad (harold) popping out of her bag.

name: Numbskull
effect:
Reassemble (When I die, create a Bone Pile.)
Play: Discard all of your bookmarks. Get that much candy.
alt: A skull with a slushie lid on it's head, full of red slushie. It's experiencing a brainfreeze.

name: Nesting Jack
effect:
Friendly (I deal no damage.)
Dies: Create 2 Jack O' Lanterns.
alt: A jovial purple skeleton wearing a Jack O' Lantern on its head, popping out of a bigger, green Jack O' Lantern.
